name: Mercenary Pit Fighters
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Pit Fighters (players/gladiator/mercenary/pit_fighters_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 3 (in brackets): mana 150 (120). Its own mana 150 (120), cooldown 30 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: Three pit fighters (600 health, 30 armor and resistance, 50 physical) for 15 s, for 150 mana.
